title: Fibrant objects of the symmetric operadic pattern model category are inert-marked symmetric infinity operads
statement: Use symmetric infinity operads, their inert edges, the pattern $\mathfrak P_{\mathrm{sym}}$ on $N(\mathsf{Fin}_*)$ and the model category $\mathsf M=\mathsf M_{\mathfrak P_{\mathrm{sym}}}$ of [lem-coef-symmetric-operadic-fibration-recognition], the $\mathfrak P$-fibered marked objects of [def-coef-categorical-pattern-fibrancy], and the model structure of [lem-coef-categorical-pattern-model-calculus]. Let $(Z,T)$, with marking-preserving structure map $q:Z\to N(\mathsf{Fin}_*)$, be a fibrant object of $\mathsf M$. Then $q$ is a symmetric infinity operad in the sense of [lem-coef-symmetric-operadic-fibration-recognition]: it is an inner fibration with $q$-cocartesian lifts of all inert pointed maps; for every $n\geq0$ the colour projections induce an equivalence $Z_{\langle n\rangle}\simeq Z_{\langle1\rangle}^n$; and for all vertices $y$ over $\langle m\rangle$ and $z$ over $\langle n\rangle$, every pointed map $\phi:\langle m\rangle\to\langle n\rangle$ and every choice of $q$-cocartesian edges $z\to z_i$ over the colour projections $\rho_i$, composition gives an equivalence $\operatorname{Map}^{\phi}_Z(y,z)\simeq\prod_{i=1}^n\operatorname{Map}^{\rho_i\phi}_Z(y,z_i)$, the superscripts denoting homotopy fibres of the maps of mapping spaces over the indicated pointed maps. Moreover $T$ is exactly the set of inert edges of $Z$, so $(Z,T)=Z^{\mathrm{in}}$. The case $n=0$ is included: $Z_{\langle0\rangle}$ is equivalent to $\Delta^0$ and each $\operatorname{Map}^{\phi}_Z(y,z)$ with $z$ over $\langle0\rangle$ is contractible. Together with the fibrancy of $Q^{\mathrm{in}}$ in [lem-coef-symmetric-operadic-fibration-recognition], the fibrant objects of $\mathsf M$ are exactly the objects $Q^{\mathrm{in}}$ for small symmetric infinity operads $Q$.
